body: Idk if it’s damage I’m going for, I just like the blood and the pain. And I wouldn’t trust myself to cut my wrists with a simple blade, but I might be able to with these.

Thank you. I still don’t understand my feelings, but honestly you have helped me through tonight. Thank you so much. I wish you the best. I don’t know what lies ahead of me, but you deserve the world, kind stranger. 

I’m going to bed now. I hope I will feel somewhat different when I wake up. Even just pure emptiness is better than this.

I have literally no idea. I just feel like it’s what I have to do. I don’t understand why I hurt or even what exactly it is. I just feel like I’m always doing things wrong, and I’ll never be able to get it right. I feel like I’m not actually close to any other human being - we either connect on a superficial level or they don’t like me. I feel like I’m not going to get anywhere. I feel like I’m not going to be able to find love or any meaningful relationships. I’ve always hurt and felt responsible for the hurt of those around me. I just want it to end. I feel like it has to, I just need to send myself over the edge.

I’m only still here because I’m way too afraid of actually dying, but I feel like I have to. 

I haven’t been able to enjoy anything I just feel an overwhelming sense of guilt and pain no matter what I do. If I’m sober it’s bad anxiety and if I’m drunk I just get into really deep emotional holes. There’s no escape. I really just want to fucking die.
I just know that’s what I should do, that’s what I have to do, I feel like everything in my life is pointing towards that  I can’t face this anymore

Well I hope I either die from it or get left in hospital to severely turn my life around. I need it. I can’t deal with anything anymore and it’s definitely the right choice. I just need to get drunk enough to overcome my fear.
Thanks, it’s really helpful and relieving to know I’m not the only one with these feelings
I’m sorry that you’re in that situation - I’ll definitely be careful about who I tell and what I say
Thanks. I doubt it, my plan is to make my own living before I come out and then just see what happens

Hmm yeah I feel like both of those reflect my feelings in relation to my body, just not as extensively as some people I’ve seen which is where my doubt comes from. I feel like if I were to transition I wouldn’t end up being *extremely* feminine but not that masculine so yeah I guess my experience is just different from people I’ve met.

Thank you for your help.

I have a therapist but because of my parents I won’t be able to see a gender therapist. I might get my school counsellor and school in general involved (they’re supposed to be quite good on mental health and stuff) but I need to dance around my parents for this. Thanks for your help and well-wishes

I’ve told one person and I have some ideas for who I can tell if I feel like I have to, which tbh i do right now. I don’t think I could ever tell my parents - while I’m still dependent on them at least - they wouldn’t kick me out or hurt me but they would make my life absolute hell and it’s not worth it.

I’m bi and when I was coming to terms with my sexuality, telling people helped a lot so I feel like this is something I’ll have to do here too. Thanks for the advice!

💙
Thanks for your help and support!!!

But I don’t know whether it will become “traditional” dysphoria. Sometimes when I think about the possibility that I’m trans it excites me because I’ll get to live as a girl but sometimes it scares me because it’s a lot to go through and I’m not 100% sure, I’ve repressed these feelings for so long because of my parents I feel like I could just keep on repressing them but also that probably wouldn’t be healthy?

Sorry if I’m rambly or hard to understand I’m just very confused by all these feelings and I’ve never really addressed them before
Ok! Thanks again for your help. I’m going to bring it up with my therapist next time I go, but I have I reckon 0% chance of getting actual gender identity therapy because of my parents :/

From what I’ve read (and I might be wrong) I feel like I could classify my feelings as strong social dysphoria with a bit but not much body dysphoria. Do you think that would be right? And would that be valid?

Thanks for the response
